name: Answer Library
description: Reusable tender answers in Arabic and English (profile, experience, quality, HSE, Saudization, local content) with review dates and expiring documents
description_ar: إجابات المناقصات القابلة لإعادة الاستخدام بالعربية والإنجليزية مع تواريخ المراجعة

name: Bid Pipeline
description: Kanban of every tender from discovery to award: go/no-go, booklet, inquiries, drafting, submission, technical then financial review, won/lost. Weighted value and win rate.
description_ar: متابعة العطاءات من الإعلان حتى الترسية

name: Saudi Work Calendar
description: Official holidays, Ramadan hours (art. 98), Sun–Thu business days, Hijri/Gregorian
description_ar: تقويم سعودي بالهجري والميلادي، الأحد–الخميس ورمضان

name: Saudi Compliance Calculators
description: End of service (Labor Law arts. 84/85/87), GOSI, VAT & Fatoora waves, Nitaqat — sourced, editable rates rates:<topic>; saved calculations private.

name: Contacts & Deals
description: CRM-lite: companies, contacts, deal pipeline (SAR) and last interaction; Super logs e-mails and meetings and mirrors HubSpot (read only)

name: Tender Deadlines
description: Etimad dates plus the GTPL delays they trigger: offer validity, standstill and final guarantee under the tender's own law (GTPL 1440: standstill art. 53, 5–10 days; GTPL 1448: art. 39, 50, 59). Countdowns in Saudi working days, hijri + gregorian.

name: Document Library
description: Index of every deliverable the agents and team produced: kind, language, version history, tags, text copies in data/

name: Expenses & Approvals
description: Expense claims with VAT 15% (ZATCA), compressed receipt photos, admin approval and reimbursement, CSV export

name: Forms & Surveys
description: Surveys and forms: stars, NPS, choices, text; anonymous or named; one row per response; admin results with charts and CSV

name: Go / No-go
description: Weighted bid/no-bid scorecard per tender: general and Saudi factors, knockouts, verdict and recorded decision; Super pre-fills
description_ar: قرار المشاركة في المناقصة بمعايير موزونة

name: KPI Dashboard
description: Upload a CSV, Super proposes the KPIs and computes them; RTL charts, editable targets, insights

name: KPI Scorecard (Adaa-style)
description: Quarterly KPI scorecard: target, actual, achievement, RAG, trend, Vision 2030 link, commentary — prepared for manual entry on Adaa

name: Minutes & Action Items
description: Formal minutes (محضر) or recaps: header, attendance and quorum, numbered decisions, actions linked to Tasks, A4 export

name: Pricing Calculator
description: Priced BoQ with margin, VAT, guarantees per law regime (GTPL 1440 / 1448), total in Arabic and English words, local-content simulation, CSV export

name: Tender Radar
description: Virtualised table of active Etimad tenders the agent found with tender_search, each with a fit score and its reasons; saved searches per member; watch, dismiss, send to the pipeline.

name: Requests & Tickets
description: Internal IT, HR, finance and facilities requests: severity, status, SLA in Saudi business days, agent triage

name: Status Reports (EXPRO format)
name_ar: تقارير حالة المشاريع (هيكل هيئة كفاءة الإنفاق)
description: Weekly/monthly project status reports in the EXPRO procedure structure, written by Super on request: RAG check, review, print-ready. Snapshots only

name: Tasks & Follow-ups
description: Kanban and table of follow-ups: assignee, due date in Saudi business days, channel, AR/EN reminders

name: Compliance Vault
description: Company certificates (CR, Zakat, GOSI, Nitaqat, Chamber, VAT, classification, local content) with hijri/gregorian expiry alerts, and a requirement → evidence matrix per tender.

name: Weekly Report
description: Sunday-to-Thursday report written by Super on request from Tasks and Minutes: done, in progress, blocked, next; editable AR/EN summary
